## Tax-incentive shocks

The right-hand side comes from the Malaysia tax-incentive shock dataset of
Degetau & Samano (2026) ([Fiscal-shocks](https://github.com/estebandegetau/Fiscal-shocks)),
published at
<https://www.estebandegetau.com/Fiscal-shocks/data/validated/MY_incentive_shocks_clean.dta>.
The pipeline tracks the remote file (`incentive_shocks_file`, `format = "url"`),
so any update upstream re-runs every downstream target.

```{r}
#| label: load-incentive-shocks

incentive_shocks <- tar_read(incentive_shocks)
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-incentive-shocks-dictionary
#| tbl-cap: "Variables in the tax-incentive shock dataset"

look_for(incentive_shocks, details = "none") |>
  as_tibble() |>
  select(Variable = variable, Label = label) |>
  tt()
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-incentive-shocks
#| tbl-cap: "Malaysia tax-incentive shocks"

incentive_shocks |>
  select(
    ID = shock_id,
    Measure = act_label,
    Category = incentive_category,
    Base = tax_type,
    Direction = direction,
    Announced = announced_year,
    Effective = effective_year,
    Motivation = motivation,
    Exogenous = exogenous
  ) |>
  tt()
```
